summary: PO 2023 section 8 (Mitteilungsblatt 18/2023): 30 ECTS basic modules, including compulsory Differentialgleichungen, 30 ECTS in one of six specializations, 30 ECTS electives, and the 30 ECTS thesis. E-Mobility is one specialization, so both of its eCampus sub-areas count toward the same 30 ECTS under the PO. Areas under Zulassung zum Master are admission conditions (section 6), outside the degree requirements in section 8.

categories.name: Basic modules
categories.note: The PO requires 30 ECTS of cross-specialization basic modules, including compulsory Differentialgleichungen (offered as Differentialgleichungen für Master Ingenieurwissenschaften, 6 ECTS). Each basic module is 6 ECTS; this semester offers four modules and 24 ECTS.

categories.name: Elective modules
categories.note: The PO requires 30 ECTS from a cross-specialization catalogue of listed electives, unused basic modules, specialization modules not counted in your own specialization, and modules the examination board approves. This area lists the electives offered here (2-8 ECTS per the PO; this semester's eCampus list also contains Forschungspraxismodul at 10 ECTS, which is outside that range); the other catalogue parts still count when that rule is met.

categories.name: One specialization of your choice
categories.note: The PO requires 30 ECTS in one of the six specializations, and each specialization module is worth 4-8 ECTS. E-Mobility is one specialization: modules from both eCampus sub-areas count toward the same 30 ECTS, and the regulations set no separate Pflicht quota; no single area path covers both sub-areas, so E-Mobility is not an option in this check.
